introduction: PIPP Plus helps eligible Ohio utility customers manage monthly electric and natural-gas payments according to household income.
description: PIPP Plus helps eligible Ohio utility customers manage monthly electric and natural-gas payments according to household income.

sections.who: You need an active account with a participating PUCO-regulated utility. OCC currently lists income at or below 175% of federal guidelines.
sections.get: Monthly payments are generally 5% of income for each gas or electric service, or 10% for an all-electric home, with a minimum payment. Full payments made on time also earn debt credits.
sections.docs:
• Photo identification and household list.
  • Recent utility bills.
  • Adult household income records requested for the relevant period.
sections.apply:
1. Apply year-round

    Use Ohio Energy Assistance or a local energy assistance provider.

  2. Confirm the calculation

    Ask which accounts participate and what your required payments will be.

  3. Record renewal dates

    Check your bill for the reverification and anniversary dates.
sections.after: Pay the full required amount by its due date, reverify annually and report household or income changes within 30 days.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using OCC PIPP Plus. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
